candidates.name: Get-WinEvent
verified_facts: Get-WinEvent retrieves events from Windows event logs and event tracing log files
FilterHashtable, XPath and XML filters can bound evidence by log, provider, identifier and time
semantic_limits: Event records are supporting evidence and do not by themselves prove that the canonical runner produced the required receipts

candidates.name: Test-Path
verified_facts: Test-Path returns true only when the requested path elements exist
PathType Leaf can distinguish required receipt files from containers
semantic_limits: A file existing is insufficient; content, identity, freshness and integrity must also pass

candidates.name: Get-FileHash
verified_facts: Get-FileHash computes a hash from file content
SHA256 is the default algorithm and a changed file content changes the hash
semantic_limits: A matching hash proves content equality to a known value, not that the external execution was legitimate unless the expected digest is independently bound

candidates.name: Test-Json
verified_facts: Test-Json tests whether input is a valid JSON document
It can optionally validate JSON against a supplied schema
semantic_limits: Syntactically valid JSON can still contain stale, incorrect or unrelated evidence

candidates.name: ConvertFrom-Json
verified_facts: ConvertFrom-Json converts JSON text into objects or hash tables with fields available for inspection
Receipt fields can be read and compared only after the JSON validity gate passes
semantic_limits: Duplicate JSON keys can collapse to the last value, so schema validation and controlled producer output remain required
